Promulgation of the Criminal Code

Hereby is promulgated the Criminal Code, cf. Consolidation Act no. 1007 of 24 October 2012, with the amendments following from § 2 of Act no. 1242 of 18 December 2012, § 2 of Act no. 1385 of 23 December 2012, § 2 of
Act no. 431 of 1 May 2013, § 1 of Act no. 434 of 1 May 2013, § 1 of Act no. 628 of 12 June 2013, § 1 of Act no.
633 of 12 June 2013, § 1 of Act no. 634 of 12 June 2013 and § 3 of Act no. 642 of 12 June 2013.
General Part
Chapter 1
Introductory provisions

text:
§ 1

Straf kan kun pålægges for et forhold, hvis strafbarhed er hjemlet ved lov, eller som ganske må ligestilles med et sådant. Med hensyn til de i kapitel 9 nævnte retsfølger gælder en tilsvarende regel.
translated_text:
§ 1

Punishment may only be imposed for an act the punishability of which is provided for by law or which must be entirely equated with such an act. With regard to the legal consequences mentioned in Chapter 9, a corresponding rule applies.

text:
§ 2

Denne lovs kapitler 1-11 finder, for så vidt ikke andet er bestemt, anvendelse på alle strafbare forhold.
2.	kapitel
Almindelige betingelser for strafferetlige bestemmelsers anvendelse
translated_text:
§ 2

Chapters 1-11 of this Act apply, unless otherwise provided, to all punishable acts.
Chapter 2
General conditions for the application of criminal law provisions

text:
§ 3

Er den ved en handlings påkendelse gældende straffelovgivning forskellig fra den, der gjaldt ved handlingens foretagelse, afgøres spørgsmålet om strafbarhed og straf efter den senere lov, dog at afgørelsen ikke derved må blive strengere end efter den ældre lov. Beror ophøret af lovens gyldighed på ydre, strafskylden uvedkommende forhold, bliver handlingen at bedømme efter den ældre lov.
Stk. 2. Bortfalder uden for sidstnævnte tilfælde ved lov en handlings strafbarhed, bortfalder også den for sådan handling idømte, men ikke fuldbyrdede straf. Den dømte kan forlange, at spørgsmålet om straffens bortfald ved påtalemyndighedens foranstaltning indbringes for den ret, der har påkendt sagen i første instans. Afgørelsen træffes ved kendelse.
translated_text:
§ 3

If the criminal legislation in force at the adjudication of an act differs from that which was in force at the commission of the act, the question of punishability and punishment shall be decided according to the later law, provided, however, that the decision shall not thereby become more severe than under the earlier law. If the cessation of the validity of the law is due to external circumstances unrelated to culpability, the act shall be assessed according to the earlier law.
Stk. 2. If, outside the latter case, the punishability of an act ceases by law, the punishment imposed for such an act but not executed shall also cease. The convicted person may request that the question of the cessation of the punishment be brought before the court which adjudicated the case at first instance by the prosecution authority. The decision shall be made by order.

text:
§ 4

Hvorvidt den strafbare handling skal medføre retsfølger af sådan art som i §§ 56-61, 62-70, 73 og 79 nævnt, afgøres efter den ved handlingens påkendelse gældende lovgivning.
Stk. 2. Andre retsfølger af handlingen indtræder, for så vidt intet modsat er bestemt, kun, når dette var hjemlet også ved den ved handlingens foretagelse gældende lovgivning.
Stk. 3. Bestemmelsen i § 3, stk. 2, finder tilsvarende anvendelse på andre retsfølger af handlingen end straf, hvis deres indtræden var betinget af handlingens strafbarhed.
translated_text:
§ 4

Whether the punishable act shall result in legal consequences of the kind mentioned in §§ 56-61, 62-70, 73 and 79 shall be decided according to the legislation in force at the adjudication of the act.
Stk. 2. Other legal consequences of the act shall, unless otherwise provided, only occur if this was also provided for by the legislation in force at the commission of the act.
Stk. 3. The provision in § 3, subsection 2, applies correspondingly to legal consequences of the act other than punishment if their occurrence was conditional upon the punishability of the act.

text:
§ 5

Hvor forhøjet straf eller andre retsfølger er foreskrevet i gentagelsestilfælde, kommer afgørelser, der er truffet i henhold til tidligere ret, i betragtning efter deres indhold lige med afgørelser efter den lov, i henhold til hvilken den foreliggende handling bedømmes.
translated_text:
§ 5

Where increased punishment or other legal consequences are prescribed in cases of recidivism, decisions made pursuant to earlier law shall be taken into account according to their content on equal terms with decisions pursuant to the law under which the present act is assessed.

heading: § 6. Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are acts which are committed
text:
§ 6. Under dansk straffemyndighed hører handlinger, som foretages

1)	i den danske stat,
2)	på dansk fartøj, som befinder sig inden for et fremmed myndighedsområde, af en person, der hører til fartøjet eller som rejsende følger med dette, eller
3)	på dansk fartøj, som befinder sig uden for et myndighedsområde.
translated_text:
§ 6. Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are acts which are committed

1)	in the Danish State,
2)	on a Danish vessel which is located within a foreign jurisdiction, by a person who belongs to the vessel or accompanies it as a passenger, or
3)	on a Danish vessel which is located outside a jurisdiction.

text:
§ 7

Under dansk straffemyndighed hører handlinger, som foretages inden for et fremmed myndigheds- område af en person, der på tidspunktet for sigtelsen har dansk indfødsret, er bosat i den danske stat eller har lignende fast ophold her i landet, hvis
1)	handlingen også er strafbar efter lovgivningen på gerningsstedet (dobbelt strafbarhed) eller
2)	gerningsmanden også på gerningstidspunktet har den nævnte tilknytning her til landet og handlingen

a)	omfatter seksuel udnyttelse af børn, menneskehandel eller kvindelig omskæring eller
b)	er rettet mod nogen, der på gerningstidspunktet har den nævnte tilknytning her til landet.
Stk. 2. Under dansk straffemyndighed hører endvidere handlinger, som foretages uden for et myndig- hedsområde af en person, der på tidspunktet for sigtelsen har den i stk. 1 nævnte tilknytning her til landet, hvis handlinger af den pågældende art kan medføre højere straf end fængsel i 4 måneder.
Stk. 3. Stk. 1, nr. 1, og stk. 2 finder tilsvarende anvendelse med hensyn til handlinger foretaget af en person, som på tidspunktet for sigtelsen har indfødsret eller er bosat i Finland, Island, Norge eller Sverige, og som opholder sig her i landet.
translated_text:
§ 7

Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are acts which are committed within a foreign jurisdiction by a person who at the time of the charge has Danish nationality, is resident in the Danish State or has similar permanent residence in this country, if
1)	the act is also punishable under the legislation at the place of commission (double criminality) or
2)	the perpetrator also at the time of commission has the said connection to this country and the act

a)	comprises sexual exploitation of children, human trafficking or female circumcision or
b)	is directed against someone who at the time of commission has the said connection to this country.
Stk. 2. Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are furthermore acts which are committed outside a jurisdiction by a person who at the time of the charge has the connection to this country mentioned in subsection 1, if acts of the kind in question may result in a punishment higher than imprisonment for 4 months.
Stk. 3. Subsection 1, no. 1, and subsection 2 apply correspondingly with regard to acts committed by a person who at the time of the charge has nationality or is resident in Finland, Iceland, Norway or Sweden and who is present in this country.

text:
§ 7

a. Under dansk straffemyndighed hører handlinger, som foretages inden for et fremmed myndig- hedsområde, og som er rettet mod nogen, der på gerningstidspunktet har dansk indfødsret, er bosat i den danske stat eller har lignende fast ophold her i landet, hvis handlingen også er strafbar efter lovgivningen på gerningsstedet (dobbelt strafbarhed) og efter dansk lovgivning kan medføre straf af fængsel i mindst 6 år.
Stk. 2. Dansk straffemyndighed efter stk. 1 er betinget af, at handlingen omfatter
1)	forsætligt drab,
2)	grov vold, frihedsberøvelse eller røveri,
3)	en almenfarlig forbrydelse,
4)	en seksualforbrydelse eller incest eller
5)	kvindelig omskæring.
Stk. 3. Under dansk straffemyndighed hører endvidere handlinger, som foretages uden for et myndig- hedsområde, og som er rettet mod nogen, der på gerningstidspunktet har den i stk. 1 nævnte tilknytning her til landet, hvis handlinger af den pågældende art kan medføre højere straf end fængsel i 4 måneder.
translated_text:
§ 7

a. Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are acts which are committed within a foreign jurisdiction and which are directed against someone who at the time of commission has Danish nationality, is resident in the Danish State or has similar permanent residence in this country, if the act is also punishable under the legislation at the place of commission (double criminality) and under Danish legislation may result in a punishment of imprisonment for at least 6 years.
Stk. 2. Danish criminal jurisdiction pursuant to subsection 1 is conditional upon the act comprising
1)	intentional homicide,
2)	serious violence, deprivation of liberty or robbery,
3)	a crime dangerous to the public,
4)	a sexual offence or incest or
5)	female circumcision.
Stk. 3. Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are furthermore acts which are committed outside a jurisdiction and which are directed against someone who at the time of commission has the connection to this country mentioned in subsection 1, if acts of the kind in question may result in a punishment higher than imprisonment for 4 months.

text:
§ 7

b. Når dansk straffemyndighed over for en juridisk person er betinget af dobbelt strafbarhed, omfatter det ikke et krav om, at lovgivningen på gerningsstedet hjemler strafansvar for en juridisk person.
translated_text:
§ 7

b. When Danish criminal jurisdiction over a legal person is conditional upon double criminality, this does not include a requirement that the legislation at the place of commission provides for criminal liability for a legal person.

text:
§ 8

Under dansk straffemyndighed hører handlinger, som foretages uden for den danske stat, uden hensyn til hvor gerningsmanden hører hjemme, når
1)	handlingen krænker den danske stats selvstændighed, sikkerhed, forfatning eller offentlige myndighe- der eller en embedspligt mod staten,
2)	handlingen krænker interesser, hvis retsbeskyttelse i den danske stat forudsætter en særlig tilknytning til denne,
3)	handlingen krænker en forpligtelse, som det ifølge lov påhviler gerningsmanden at iagttage i udlan- det,
4)	handlingen krænker en tjenestepligt, som påhviler gerningsmanden over for dansk fartøj,
5)	handlingen er omfattet af en international bestemmelse, ifølge hvilken Danmark er forpligtet til at have straffemyndighed, eller
6)	udlevering af sigtede til retsforfølgning i et andet land afslås, og handlingen, for så vidt den er foretaget inden for et fremmed myndighedsområde, er strafbar efter lovgivningen på gerningsstedet (dobbelt strafbarhed) og handlingen efter dansk lovgivning kan medføre straf af fængsel i mindst 1 år.
translated_text:
§ 8

Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are acts which are committed outside the Danish State, regardless of where the perpetrator belongs, when
1)	the act violates the independence, security, constitution or public authorities of the Danish State or an official duty towards the State,
2)	the act violates interests whose legal protection in the Danish State presupposes a special connection to it,
3)	the act violates an obligation which according to law the perpetrator is required to observe abroad,
4)	the act violates a duty of service which the perpetrator owes to a Danish vessel,
5)	the act is covered by an international provision according to which Denmark is obliged to have criminal jurisdiction, or
6)	extradition of the accused for prosecution in another country is refused and the act, insofar as it is committed within a foreign jurisdiction, is punishable under the legislation at the place of commission (double criminality) and the act under Danish legislation may result in a punishment of imprisonment for at least 1 year.

text:
§ 8

a. Under dansk straffemyndighed hører handlinger, som foretages uden for den danske stat, når handlinger af den pågældende art er omfattet af statutten for Den Internationale Straffedomstol, hvis handlingen er foretaget af en person, der på tidspunktet for sigtelsen
1)	har dansk indfødsret, er bosat i den danske stat eller har lignende fast ophold her i landet eller
2)	befinder sig her i landet.
translated_text:
§ 8

a. Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are acts which are committed outside the Danish State when acts of the kind in question are covered by the Statute of the International Criminal Court, if the act is committed by a person who at the time of the charge
1)	has Danish nationality, is resident in the Danish State or has similar permanent residence in this country or
2)	is present in this country.

text:
§ 8

b. Under dansk straffemyndighed hører handlinger, som foretages uden for den danske stat, når handlingen er omfattet af § 183 a og er foretaget af en person, der på tidspunktet for sigtelsen
1)	har dansk indfødsret, er bosat i den danske stat eller har lignende fast ophold her i landet eller

2)	befinder sig her i landet.
Stk. 2. Retsforfølgning for handlinger omfattet af stk. 1 kan tillige omfatte overtrædelser af §§ 237 og 244-248, som er begået i forbindelse med overtrædelsen af § 183 a.
translated_text:
§ 8

b. Under Danish criminal jurisdiction are acts which are committed outside the Danish State when the act is covered by § 183 a and is committed by a person who at the time of the charge
1)	has Danish nationality, is resident in the Danish State or has similar permanent residence in this country or

2)	is present in this country.
Stk. 2. Prosecution for acts covered by subsection 1 may also include violations of §§ 237 and 244-248 which are committed in connection with the violation of § 183 a.

text:
§ 9

Handlinger anses for foretaget, hvor gerningsmanden befandt sig ved handlingens foretagelse. For så vidt angår juridiske personer, anses handlinger for foretaget, hvor den eller de handlinger, som medfører ansvar for den juridiske person, er foretaget.
Stk. 2. Hvis en handlings strafbarhed afhænger af eller påvirkes af en indtrådt eller tilsigtet følge, anses handlingen tillige for foretaget, hvor virkningen er indtrådt, eller hvor gerningsmanden har forsæt til, at virkningen skulle indtræde.
Stk. 3. Forsøgs- og medvirkenshandlinger anses for foretaget i den danske stat, hvis gerningsmanden befandt sig her i landet ved handlingens foretagelse, uanset om lovovertrædelsen fuldbyrdes eller tilsigtes fuldbyrdet uden for den danske stat.
Stk. 4. Når en del af en lovovertrædelse er begået i den danske stat, anses lovovertrædelsen i sin helhed for at være begået her i landet.
translated_text:
§ 9

Acts are considered committed where the perpetrator was located at the time of committing the act. With regard to legal persons, acts are considered committed where the act or acts that entail liability for the legal person were committed.
Subsection 2. If the punishability of an act depends on or is affected by an occurred or intended consequence, the act is also considered committed where the effect occurred, or where the perpetrator had intent that the effect should occur.
Subsection 3. Attempt and complicity acts are considered committed in the Danish state if the perpetrator was located in this country at the time of committing the act, regardless of whether the offence is completed or intended to be completed outside the Danish state.
Subsection 4. When part of an offence has been committed in the Danish state, the offence in its entirety is considered to have been committed in this country.

text:
§ 9

a. En lovovertrædelse, der vedrører tekst-, lyd- eller billedmateriale m.v., som ved handlinger i udlandet er gjort alment tilgængeligt her i landet gennem internettet eller et lignende system til spredning af information, anses for begået i den danske stat, hvis materialet har særlig relation her til landet.
translated_text:
§ 9

a. An offence concerning text, sound or image material etc., which by acts abroad has been made generally accessible in this country through the internet or a similar system for dissemination of information, is considered committed in the Danish state if the material has a special connection to this country.

text:
§ 10

Når en handling retsforfølges her i landet, skal afgørelsen om såvel straf som andre retsfølger af handlingen træffes efter dansk lovgivning.
Stk. 2. Når dansk straffemyndighed er betinget af dobbelt strafbarhed, kan der ikke idømmes strengere straf end hjemlet ved lovgivningen på gerningsstedet.
translated_text:
§ 10

When an act is prosecuted in this country, the decision on both punishment and other legal consequences of the act shall be made according to Danish legislation.
Subsection 2. When Danish criminal jurisdiction is conditional on double criminality, no more severe punishment may be imposed than provided for by the legislation at the place of commission.

text:
§ 10

a. En person, over for hvem der uden for den danske stat er afsagt en straffedom, kan ikke retsforfølges her i landet for den samme handling, når dette er udelukket ifølge Danmarks internationale forpligtelser om anerkendelse af straffedommes retskraft.
Stk. 2. I andre tilfælde kan en person, over for hvem der uden for den danske stat er afsagt en straffedom, ikke retsforfølges her i landet for den samme handling, hvis
1)	personen er endeligt frifundet,
2)	den idømte sanktion er fuldbyrdet, er under fuldbyrdelse eller er bortfaldet efter lovgivningen i domslandet eller
3)	personen er fundet skyldig, uden at der er fastsat nogen sanktion.
Stk. 3. Stk. 2 gælder ikke, når
1)	den udenlandske straffedom vedrører handlinger, der
a)	anses for foretaget i den danske stat i medfør af § 9 eller § 9 a eller
b)	er omfattet af § 7, stk. 1, nr. 2, eller § 8, nr. 1 eller 2,
2)	retsforfølgning her i landet finder sted i medfør af retsplejelovens § 985 a eller
3)	anerkendelse af den udenlandske straffedom vil være åbenbart uforenelig med danske retsprincipper.
Stk. 4. I de tilfælde, der er nævnt i stk. 3, nr. 1, kan retsforfølgning her i landet ikke ske, når retsforfølgning i domslandet er sket efter anmodning fra den danske anklagemyndighed.
translated_text:
§ 10

a. A person against whom a criminal sentence has been passed outside the Danish state cannot be prosecuted in this country for the same act when this is excluded pursuant to Denmark's international obligations concerning recognition of the legal effect of criminal sentences.
Subsection 2. In other cases, a person against whom a criminal sentence has been passed outside the Danish state cannot be prosecuted in this country for the same act if
1)	the person has been finally acquitted,
2)	the imposed sanction has been enforced, is being enforced or has lapsed according to the legislation in the country of judgment or
3)	the person has been found guilty without any sanction being imposed.
Subsection 3. Subsection 2 does not apply when
1)	the foreign criminal sentence concerns acts that
a)	are considered committed in the Danish state pursuant to § 9 or § 9 a or
b)	are covered by § 7, subsection 1, no. 2, or § 8, no. 1 or 2,
2)	prosecution in this country takes place pursuant to the Administration of Justice Act § 985 a or
3)	recognition of the foreign criminal sentence would be manifestly incompatible with Danish legal principles.
Subsection 4. In the cases mentioned in subsection 3, no. 1, prosecution in this country cannot take place when prosecution in the country of judgment has taken place at the request of the Danish prosecution authority.

text:
§ 10

b. Sker der retsforfølgning mod en person, som uden for den danske stat er pålagt en sanktion for samme handling, skal den sanktion, der pålægges her i landet, nedsættes, i det omfang den udenlandske sanktion er fuldbyrdet.
translated_text:
§ 10

b. If prosecution takes place against a person who outside the Danish state has been imposed a sanction for the same act, the sanction imposed in this country shall be reduced to the extent that the foreign sanction has been enforced.

text:
§ 11

Er en person, der har dansk indfødsret, er bosat i den danske stat eller har lignende fast ophold her i landet, i en fremmed stat straffet for en handling, der efter dansk ret kan medføre frakendelse eller fortabelse af kald eller erhverv eller anden rettighed, kan frakendelse heraf ske efter offentlig påtale her i landet.
translated_text:
§ 11

If a person who has Danish citizenship, is resident in the Danish state or has similar permanent residence in this country, has been punished in a foreign state for an act that under Danish law may result in disqualification or forfeiture of vocation or occupation or other right, disqualification thereof may take place following public prosecution in this country.

text:
§ 12

Anvendelsen af §§ 6-11 begrænses ved de i folkeretten anerkendte undtagelser.
3.	kapitel
Strafbarhedsbetingelser
translated_text:
§ 12

The application of §§ 6-11 is limited by the exceptions recognized in international law.
3.	Chapter
Conditions of punishability

text:
§ 13

Handlinger foretagne i nødværge er straffri, for så vidt de har været nødvendige for at modstå eller afværge et påbegyndt eller overhængende uretmæssigt angreb og ikke åbenbart går ud over, hvad der under hensyn til angrebets farlighed, angriberens person og det angrebne retsgodes betydning er forsvarligt.
Stk. 2. Overskrider nogen grænserne for lovligt nødværge, bliver han dog straffri, hvis overskridelsen er rimeligt begrundet i den ved angrebet fremkaldte skræk eller ophidselse.
Stk. 3. Tilsvarende regler finder anvendelse på handlinger, som er nødvendige for på retmæssig måde at skaffe lovlige påbud adlydt, iværksætte en lovlig pågribelse eller hindre en fanges eller tvangsanbragt persons rømning.
translated_text:
§ 13

Acts committed in self-defence are not punishable insofar as they have been necessary to resist or avert a commenced or imminent unlawful attack and do not manifestly exceed what, having regard to the danger of the attack, the attacker's person and the importance of the legal interest attacked, is justifiable.
Subsection 2. If anyone exceeds the limits of lawful self-defence, he nevertheless becomes exempt from punishment if the excess is reasonably justified by the fear or agitation caused by the attack.
Subsection 3. Corresponding rules apply to acts that are necessary to lawfully secure compliance with lawful orders, effect a lawful arrest or prevent the escape of a prisoner or compulsorily placed person.

text:
§ 14

En handling, der ellers ville være strafbar, straffes ikke, når den var nødvendig til afværgelse af truende skade på person eller gods, og lovovertrædelsen måtte anses for at være af forholdsvis underordnet betydning.
translated_text:
§ 14

An act that would otherwise be punishable is not punished when it was necessary to avert a threatening harm to person or property, and the offence must be considered to be of relatively minor importance.

heading: § 15. Acts committed by children under 15 years of age are not punished
text:
§ 15. Handlinger foretagne af børn under 15 år straffes ikke

§ 16

Personer, der på gerningstiden var utilregnelige på grund af sindssygdom eller tilstande, der må ligestilles hermed, straffes ikke. Tilsvarende gælder personer, der var mentalt retarderede i højere grad. Befandt gerningsmanden sig som følge af indtagelse af alkohol eller andre rusmidler forbigående i en tilstand af sindssygdom eller i en tilstand, der må ligestilles hermed, kan straf dog pålægges, når særlige omstændigheder taler derfor.
Stk. 2. Personer, der på gerningstiden var mentalt retarderede i lettere grad, straffes ikke, medmindre særlige omstændigheder taler for at pålægge straf. Tilsvarende gælder personer, der befandt sig i en tilstand, som ganske må ligestilles med mental retardering.
translated_text:
§ 15. Acts committed by children under 15 years of age are not punished

§ 16

Persons who at the time of the act were not accountable due to mental illness or conditions that must be equated therewith are not punished. The same applies to persons who were mentally retarded to a higher degree. If the perpetrator was temporarily in a state of mental illness or in a state that must be equated therewith as a result of consumption of alcohol or other intoxicants, punishment may however be imposed when special circumstances argue for it.
Subsection 2. Persons who at the time of the act were mentally retarded to a lesser degree are not punished unless special circumstances argue for imposing punishment. The same applies to persons who were in a condition that must be entirely equated with mental retardation.

heading: §§ 17-18. (Repealed)
text:
§§ 17-18. (Ophævet)

§ 19

Uagtsomhed straffes ved de i denne lov omhandlede lovovertrædelser kun, når det er særligt hjemlet. På andre lovovertrædelser er de pågældende straffebud anvendelige, også når lovovertrædelsen er begået af uagtsomhed, medmindre det modsatte har særlig hjemmel.
translated_text:
§§ 17-18. (Repealed)

§ 19

Negligence is punished in the offences covered by this Act only when it is specifically provided for. For other offences, the relevant penal provisions are applicable also when the offence has been committed by negligence, unless the contrary is specifically provided for.

text:
§ 20

Hvor straf eller forhøjet straf betinges af, at en forsætlig lovovertrædelse har en bestemt uforsætlig følge, indtræder denne straf dog kun, når sådan følge kan tilregnes gerningsmanden som uagtsom, eller han har undladt efter evne at afværge den, efter at han er blevet opmærksom på faren.
4.	kapitel
Forsøg og medvirken
translated_text:
§ 20

Where punishment or increased punishment is conditional on an intentional offence having a specific unintentional consequence, this punishment only applies when such consequence can be attributed to the perpetrator as negligent, or he has failed to the best of his ability to avert it after he has become aware of the danger.
4.	Chapter
Attempt and complicity

text:
§ 21

Handlinger, som sigter til at fremme eller bevirke udførelsen af en forbrydelse, straffes, når denne ikke fuldbyrdes, som forsøg.
Stk. 2. Den for lovovertrædelsen foreskrevne straf kan ved forsøg nedsættes, navnlig når forsøget vidner om ringe styrke eller fasthed i det forbryderiske forsæt.
Stk. 3. For så vidt ikke andet er bestemt, straffes forsøg kun, når der for lovovertrædelsen kan idømmes en straf, der overstiger fængsel i 4 måneder.
translated_text:
§ 21

Acts that aim to promote or bring about the commission of a crime are punished, when it is not completed, as attempt.
Subsection 2. The punishment prescribed for the offence may be reduced for attempt, particularly when the attempt evidences little strength or firmness in the criminal intent.
Subsection 3. Unless otherwise provided, attempt is only punished when a punishment exceeding imprisonment for 4 months may be imposed for the offence.

text:
§ 22

Forsøg straffes ikke, når gerningsmanden frivilligt og ikke på grund af tilfældige hindringer for gerningens udførelse eller for opnåelsen af det ved denne tilsigtede øjemed afstår fra iværksættelsen eller hindrer fuldbyrdelsen eller foretager handlinger, som ville have hindret fuldbyrdelsen, hvis denne ikke, ham uafvidende, var mislykkedes eller ad anden vej var afværget.
translated_text:
§ 22

Attempt is not punished when the perpetrator voluntarily and not due to accidental obstacles to the commission of the act or to the achievement of the objective intended thereby desists from the implementation or prevents the completion or performs acts that would have prevented the completion if this had not, unknown to him, failed or been averted by other means.

text:
§ 23

Den for en lovovertrædelse givne straffebestemmelse omfatter alle, der ved tilskyndelse, råd eller dåd har medvirket til gerningen. Straffen kan nedsættes for den, der kun har villet yde en mindre væsentlig bistand eller styrke et allerede fattet forsæt, samt når forbrydelsen ikke er fuldbyrdet eller en tilsigtet medvirken er mislykkedes.
Stk. 2. Straffen kan ligeledes nedsættes for den, der medvirker til krænkelse af et særligt pligtforhold, men selv står uden for dette.
Stk. 3. For så vidt ikke andet er bestemt, kan straf for medvirken ved lovovertrædelser, der ikke straffes med højere straf end fængsel i 4 måneder, bortfalde, når den medvirkende kun har villet yde en mindre væsentlig bistand eller styrke et allerede fattet forsæt, samt når hans medvirken skyldes uagtsomhed.
translated_text:
§ 23

The penal provision given for an offence covers all who by instigation, advice or deed have contributed to the act. The punishment may be reduced for anyone who only intended to provide less significant assistance or strengthen an already formed intent, and when the crime has not been completed or an intended complicity has failed.
Subsection 2. The punishment may likewise be reduced for anyone who contributes to the violation of a special duty relationship but himself stands outside this.
Subsection 3. Unless otherwise provided, punishment for complicity in offences that are not punished with a punishment higher than imprisonment for 4 months may be omitted when the accomplice only intended to provide less significant assistance or strengthen an already formed intent, and when his complicity is due to negligence.

text:
§ 24

Den medvirkende straffes ikke, hvis han under de i § 22 angivne betingelser hindrer fuldbyrdelsen eller foretager handlinger, som ville have hindret fuldbyrdelsen, hvis denne ikke, ham uafvidende, var mislykkedes eller ad anden vej var afværget.
5.	kapitel
Strafansvar for juridiske personer
translated_text:
§ 24

The accomplice is not punished if he under the conditions specified in § 22 prevents the completion or performs acts that would have prevented the completion if this had not, unknown to him, failed or been averted by other means.
5.	Chapter
Criminal liability for legal persons

text:
§ 25

En juridisk person kan straffes med bøde, når det er bestemt ved eller i medfør af lov.
translated_text:
§ 25

A legal person may be punished with a fine when it is provided by or pursuant to law.

text:
§ 26

Bestemmelser om strafansvar for selskaber m.v. omfatter, medmindre andet er bestemt, enhver juridisk person, herunder aktie-, anparts- og andelsselskaber, interessentskaber, foreninger, fonde, boer, kommuner og statslige myndigheder.
Stk. 2. Endvidere omfatter sådanne bestemmelser enkeltmandsvirksomheder, for så vidt disse navnlig under hensyn til deres størrelse og organisation kan sidestilles med de i stk. 1 nævnte selskaber.
translated_text:
§ 26

Provisions on criminal liability for companies etc. cover, unless otherwise determined, any legal person, including limited liability companies, private limited companies and cooperative societies, partnerships, associations, foundations, estates, municipalities and state authorities.
Subsection 2. Furthermore, such provisions cover sole proprietorships, insofar as these, particularly having regard to their size and organisation, can be equated with the companies mentioned in subsection 1.

text:
§ 27

Strafansvar for en juridisk person forudsætter, at der inden for dens virksomhed er begået en overtrædelse, der kan tilregnes en eller flere til den juridiske person knyttede personer eller den juridiske person som sådan. For så vidt angår straf for forsøg, finder § 21, stk. 3, tilsvarende anvendelse.
Stk. 2. Statslige myndigheder og kommuner kan alene straffes i anledning af overtrædelser, der begås ved udøvelse af virksomhed, der svarer til eller kan sidestilles med virksomhed udøvet af private.
translated_text:
§ 27

Criminal liability for a legal person presupposes that within its business an offence has been committed which can be attributed to one or more persons connected to the legal person or to the legal person as such. As regards punishment for attempt, section 21, subsection 3, applies correspondingly.
Subsection 2. State authorities and municipalities can only be punished in connection with offences committed in the exercise of activities that correspond to or can be equated with activities exercised by private parties.

heading: §§ 28-30. (Repealed)
text:
§§ 28-30. (Ophævet)

6.	kapitel
Straffene
translated_text:
§§ 28-30. (Repealed)

6.	Chapter
Punishments

heading: § 31. The ordinary punishments are imprisonment and fines
text:
§ 31. De almindelige straffe er fængsel og bøde

§ 32. (Ophævet)

§ 33

Fængsel idømmes på livstid eller på tid, ikke under 7 dage og ikke over 16 år.
Stk. 2. I tilfælde, hvor der er hjemmel til at forhøje den straf, der er foreskrevet for en lovovertrædelse, kan der dog idømmes fængsel indtil 20 år.
Stk. 3. En gerningsmand, der ikke var fyldt 18 år, da gerningen blev udført, kan ikke idømmes fængsel på livstid.
Stk. 4. Når fængsel idømmes for kortere tid end 3 måneder, fastsættes straffen i dage, ellers i måneder og år.
translated_text:
§ 31. The ordinary punishments are imprisonment and fines

§ 32. (Repealed)

§ 33

Imprisonment is imposed for life or for a term, not less than 7 days and not more than 16 years.
Subsection 2. In cases where there is authority to increase the punishment prescribed for an offence, imprisonment of up to 20 years may, however, be imposed.
Subsection 3. An offender who had not reached the age of 18 when the act was committed cannot be sentenced to imprisonment for life.
Subsection 4. When imprisonment is imposed for less than 3 months, the punishment is fixed in days, otherwise in months and years.

heading: §§ 34-37. (Repealed)
text:
§§ 34-37. (Ophævet)

§ 38

Når to tredjedele af straffetiden, dog mindst 2 måneder, er udstået, afgør justitsministeren eller den, han bemyndiger dertil, om den dømte skal løslades på prøve.

Stk. 2. Løsladelse på prøve kan ske tidligere, når særlige omstændigheder taler derfor, og den dømte har udstået halvdelen af straffetiden, dog mindst 2 måneder. Bestemmelse herom træffes af justitsministeren eller den, som han med hensyn til bestemte grupper af sager bemyndiger dertil.
Stk. 3. Prøveløsladelse kan ikke ske med hensyn til den ubetingede del af en dom efter § 58, stk. 1.
Stk. 4. Løsladelse på prøve forudsætter, at den dømtes forhold ikke gør løsladelsen utilrådelig, at der er sikret ham passende ophold og arbejde eller andet underhold, og at han erklærer at ville overholde de vilkår for løsladelsen, som fastsættes efter § 39, stk. 2.
translated_text:
§§ 34-37. (Repealed)

§ 38

When two thirds of the term of punishment, but at least 2 months, has been served, the Minister of Justice or a person authorised by him decides whether the convicted person shall be released on probation.

Subsection 2. Release on probation may take place earlier when special circumstances speak in favour thereof and the convicted person has served half of the term of punishment, but at least 2 months. Decision on this is made by the Minister of Justice or a person whom he authorises with respect to specific groups of cases.
Subsection 3. Probation release cannot take place with respect to the unconditional part of a sentence under section 58, subsection 1.
Subsection 4. Release on probation presupposes that the convicted person's circumstances do not make release inadvisable, that suitable accommodation and work or other means of support has been secured for him, and that he declares his willingness to comply with the conditions for release which are laid down pursuant to section 39, subsection 2.

text:
§ 39

Løsladelse betinges af, at den pågældende ikke i prøvetiden begår strafbart forhold. Prøvetiden kan ikke overstige 3 år. Hvis den resterende straffetid overstiger 3 år, kan der dog fastsættes en prøvetid på indtil 5 år.
Stk. 2. Det kan fastsættes som vilkår for løsladelsen, at den pågældende i hele prøvetiden eller en del af denne undergives tilsyn. Yderligere vilkår kan fastsættes efter reglerne i § 57. Vilkår om ophold i hjem, hospital eller anden institution har ikke gyldighed for længere tidsrum end den resterende straffetid.
translated_text:
§ 39

Release is conditional upon the person concerned not committing a criminal offence during the probation period. The probation period cannot exceed 3 years. If the remaining term of punishment exceeds 3 years, however, a probation period of up to 5 years may be fixed.
Subsection 2. It may be laid down as a condition for release that the person concerned shall be subject to supervision during the whole probation period or part thereof. Further conditions may be laid down pursuant to the rules in section 57. A condition concerning residence in a home, hospital or other institution has no validity for a longer period than the remaining term of punishment.

text:
§ 40

Begår den prøveløsladte nyt strafbart forhold i prøvetiden, og foretages der inden dennes udløb rettergangsskridt, hvorved han sigtes for forholdet, træffer retten afgørelse i overensstemmelse med § 61, stk. 2, således at reststraffen ligestilles med en betinget dom. Har prøveløsladelse i medfør af § 40 a, stk. 3 eller 4, været forbundet med vilkår om samfundstjeneste, skal der ved fastsættelse af en fællesstraf tages hensyn til omfanget af den udførte samfundstjeneste.
Stk. 2. Overtræder den prøveløsladte i øvrigt de fastsatte vilkår, kan justitsministeren
1)	tildele advarsel,
2)	ændre vilkårene og forlænge prøvetiden inden for den i § 39 fastsatte længstetid eller
3)	under særlige omstændigheder bestemme, at han skal indsættes til udståelse af reststraffen.
Stk. 3. Begår den prøveløsladte strafbart forhold i prøvetiden, uden at der rejses tiltale herfor, finder reglerne i stk. 2 tilsvarende anvendelse. Det samme gælder, såfremt den prøveløsladte i udlandet dømmes for strafbart forhold begået i prøvetiden, uden at der i forbindelse med dommen er taget stilling til spørgsmålet om fuldbyrdelse af reststraffen.
Stk. 4. Afgørelse efter stk. 2, jf. stk. 3, kan kun træffes inden prøvetidens udløb.
Stk. 5. Træffes der ikke bestemmelse om fuldbyrdelse af reststraffen efter stk. 1 eller stk. 2, jf. stk. 3, anses straffen for udstået på det tidspunkt, da prøveløsladelse fandt sted.
Stk. 6. Såfremt genindsættelse er bestemt i medfør af stk. 2, jf. stk. 3, kan fornyet prøveløsladelse ske, selv om de tidsmæssige betingelser i § 38, stk. 1 og 2, eller § 40 a, stk. 1, ikke er opfyldt med hensyn til reststraffen. Ved afgørelse efter 1. pkt. skal der tages hensyn til omfanget af samfundstjeneste, som den pågældende har udført i medfør af § 40 a, stk. 3 eller 4. Med hensyn til prøvetid efter sådan prøveløsladelse gælder de i § 39 fastsatte tider med fradrag af den tid, i hvilken den pågældende tidligere har været prøveløsladt.
translated_text:
§ 40

If the person released on probation commits a new criminal offence during the probation period and, before its expiry, procedural steps are taken whereby he is charged with the offence, the court makes a decision in accordance with section 61, subsection 2, so that the remaining sentence is treated as a suspended sentence. If probation release pursuant to section 40 a, subsection 3 or 4, has been combined with a condition of community service, account shall be taken of the extent of the community service performed when fixing a combined sentence.
Subsection 2. If the person released on probation otherwise violates the conditions laid down, the Minister of Justice may
1)	issue a warning,
2)	alter the conditions and extend the probation period within the maximum period laid down in section 39, or
3)	in special circumstances decide that he shall be committed to serve the remaining sentence.
Subsection 3. If the person released on probation commits a criminal offence during the probation period without prosecution being brought for it, the rules in subsection 2 apply correspondingly. The same applies if the person released on probation is convicted abroad of a criminal offence committed during the probation period without the question of enforcement of the remaining sentence having been addressed in connection with the conviction.
Subsection 4. A decision pursuant to subsection 2, cf. subsection 3, can only be made before the expiry of the probation period.
Subsection 5. If no decision is made on enforcement of the remaining sentence pursuant to subsection 1 or subsection 2, cf. subsection 3, the sentence is deemed to have been served at the time when probation release took place.
Subsection 6. If recommitment has been decided pursuant to subsection 2, cf. subsection 3, renewed probation release may take place even if the temporal conditions in section 38, subsections 1 and 2, or section 40 a, subsection 1, are not fulfilled with respect to the remaining sentence. When making a decision pursuant to the 1st sentence, account shall be taken of the extent of community service which the person concerned has performed pursuant to section 40 a, subsection 3 or 4. With respect to the probation period following such probation release, the periods laid down in section 39 apply with deduction of the time during which the person concerned was previously released on probation.

text:
§ 40

a. Når halvdelen af straffetiden, dog mindst 2 måneder, er udstået, kan justitsministeren eller den, ministeren bemyndiger dertil, ud over de i § 38, stk. 2, nævnte tilfælde beslutte, at den dømte skal løslades på prøve, hvis hensynet til retshåndhævelsen skønnes ikke at tale imod det, og
1)	den dømte har ydet en særlig indsats for ikke på ny at begå kriminalitet, herunder ved at deltage i behandlingsforløb, uddannelsesforløb, arbejdstræning eller arbejde, eller
2)	den dømtes forhold taler derfor.
Stk. 2. Det fastsættes som vilkår for prøveløsladelse efter stk. 1, at den dømte undergives tilsyn indtil det tidspunkt, hvor der er forløbet to tredjedele af straffetiden. Efter dette tidspunkt kan der fastsættes vilkår om, at den pågældende fortsat undergives tilsyn.
Stk. 3. Som vilkår for prøveløsladelse efter stk. 1, nr. 1, kan fastsættes et eller flere yderligere vilkår efter reglerne i § 57 og vilkår om, at den dømte skal udføre ulønnet samfundstjeneste.

Stk. 4. Som vilkår for prøveløsladelse efter stk. 1, nr. 2, fastsættes, at den dømte skal udføre ulønnet samfundstjeneste. Der kan fastsættes yderligere vilkår efter reglerne i § 57.
Stk. 5. Vilkår om samfundstjeneste kan ikke udstrækkes ud over to tredjedele af straffetiden. Tilsyns- myndigheden kan dog træffe afgørelse om, at vilkår om samfundstjeneste skal have en varighed ud over dette tidspunkt, hvis særlige grunde taler derfor, dog ikke ud over den samlede straffetid.
Stk. 6. Prøveløsladelse i medfør af denne bestemmelse forudsætter, at den dømtes forhold ikke gør løsladelse utilrådelig, at der er sikret den dømte passende ophold og arbejde eller andet underhold, samt at den dømte er egnet til og erklærer sig villig til at overholde de vilkår for løsladelsen, som fastsættes efter stk. 3 og 4.
Stk. 7. Bestemmelserne i § 38, stk. 3, § 39, stk. 1 og stk. 2, 3. pkt., § 40 og § 63, stk. 1, 1. pkt., finder tilsvarende anvendelse.
translated_text:
§ 40

a. When half of the term of punishment, but at least 2 months, has been served, the Minister of Justice or a person authorised by the Minister may, in addition to the cases mentioned in section 38, subsection 2, decide that the convicted person shall be released on probation if regard for the enforcement of the law is deemed not to speak against it, and
1)	the convicted person has made a special effort not to commit crime again, including by participating in treatment programmes, educational programmes, work training or work, or
2)	the convicted person's circumstances speak in favour thereof.
Subsection 2. It is laid down as a condition for probation release pursuant to subsection 1 that the convicted person shall be subject to supervision until the time when two thirds of the term of punishment has elapsed. After this time, a condition may be laid down that the person concerned continues to be subject to supervision.
Subsection 3. As a condition for probation release pursuant to subsection 1, no. 1, one or more further conditions may be laid down pursuant to the rules in section 57 and a condition that the convicted person shall perform unpaid community service.

Subsection 4. As a condition for probation release pursuant to subsection 1, no. 2, it is laid down that the convicted person shall perform unpaid community service. Further conditions may be laid down pursuant to the rules in section 57.
Subsection 5. A condition of community service cannot extend beyond two thirds of the term of punishment. The supervisory authority may, however, decide that a condition of community service shall have a duration beyond this time if special reasons speak in favour thereof, but not beyond the total term of punishment.
Subsection 6. Probation release pursuant to this provision presupposes that the convicted person's circumstances do not make release inadvisable, that suitable accommodation and work or other means of support has been secured for the convicted person, and that the convicted person is suitable for and declares his willingness to comply with the conditions for release which are laid down pursuant to subsections 3 and 4.
Subsection 7. The provisions in section 38, subsection 3, section 39, subsection 1 and subsection 2, 3rd sentence, section 40 and section 63, subsection 1, 1st sentence, apply correspondingly.

text:
§ 41

Når 12 år af en straf af fængsel på livstid er udstået, afgør justitsministeren, om den dømte skal løslades på prøve.
Stk. 2. Løsladelse på prøve forudsætter, at den dømtes forhold ikke gør løsladelse utilrådelig, at der er sikret den pågældende passende ophold og arbejde eller andet underhold, og at den pågældende erklærer at ville overholde de vilkår for løsladelsen, som fastsættes efter stk. 3, 3. pkt.
Stk. 3. Løsladelse betinges af, at den dømte ikke i prøvetiden begår strafbart forhold, og at den pågældende overholder de vilkår, som måtte være fastsat. Prøvetiden kan ikke overstige 5 år.
translated_text:
§ 41

When 12 years of a sentence of imprisonment for life has been served, the Minister of Justice decides whether the convicted person shall be released on probation.
Subsection 2. Release on probation presupposes that the convicted person's circumstances do not make release inadvisable, that suitable accommodation and work or other means of support has been secured for the person concerned, and that the person concerned declares his willingness to comply with the conditions for release which are laid down pursuant to subsection 3, 3rd sentence.
Subsection 3. Release is conditional upon the convicted person not committing a criminal offence during the probation period and that the person concerned complies with any conditions that may have been laid down. The probation period cannot exceed 5 years.

heading: § 57 applies correspondingly

§ 57 finder tilsvarende anvendelse

§ 42

Begår den prøveløsladte nyt strafbart forhold i prøvetiden, og foretages der inden dennes udløb rettergangsskridt, hvorved den pågældende sigtes for forholdet, kan retten ved dom træffe afgørelse om, at den pågældende skal genindsættes til udståelse af livstidsstraffen. Når omstændighederne taler derfor, kan retten i stedet idømme straf alene for det nye forhold, eventuelt i forbindelse med en ændring af vilkårene for prøveløsladelsen.
Stk. 2. Overtræder den prøveløsladte i øvrigt vilkårene, finder § 40, stk. 2-5, jf.

If the person released on probation commits a new criminal offence during the probationary period, and before its expiry procedural steps are taken whereby the person is charged with the offence, the court may by judgment decide that the person shall be reimprisoned to serve the life sentence. When circumstances warrant it, the court may instead impose punishment only for the new offence, possibly in conjunction with a modification of the conditions for the probationary release.
Stk. 2. If the person released on probation otherwise violates the conditions, § 40, stk. 2-5, cf.

text:
§ 41

, stk. 3, tilsvarende anvendelse.
translated_text:
§ 41

, stk. 3, applies correspondingly.

text:
§ 43

Ved hel eller delvis eftergivelse af en straf ved betinget benådning kan det fastsættes som vilkår for benådningen, at bestemmelserne i § 40, stk. 1-5, eller § 42 finder tilsvarende anvendelse.
translated_text:
§ 43

In the event of full or partial remission of a sentence by conditional pardon, it may be stipulated as a condition for the pardon that the provisions of § 40, stk. 1-5, or § 42 apply correspondingly.

heading: §§ 44-49. (Repealed)
text:
§§ 44-49. (Ophævet)

§ 50. Bøde tilfalder statskassen

Stk. 2. Bøde kan idømmes som tillægsstraf til anden strafart, når tiltalte ved lovovertrædelsen har opnået eller tilsigtet at opnå økonomisk vinding for sig selv eller andre.
Stk. 3. Den bødefældte kan ikke kræve bøden betalt eller erstattet af andre.
translated_text:
§§ 44-49. (Repealed)

§ 50. Fines accrue to the Treasury

Stk. 2. A fine may be imposed as an additional penalty to another type of punishment when the accused has obtained or intended to obtain financial gain for himself or others by the offence.
Stk. 3. The person fined cannot require the fine to be paid or compensated by others.

text:
§ 51

Når bøde i henhold til denne lov idømmes eller vedtages i retten, fastsættes bødestraffen i dagbøder. Dette gælder dog ikke bøder, der pålægges som tillægsstraf til anden retsfølge. Dagbødernes antal bestemmes under hensyn til lovovertrædelsens beskaffenhed og de i § 80 nævnte omstændigheder til mindst 1 og højst 60. Størrelsen af den enkelte dagbod fastsættes til et beløb svarende til den pågældendes gennemsnitlige dagsindtægt, idet der dog ved beløbets fastsættelse bør tages hensyn til bødefældtes livsvilkår, herunder hans formue, forsørgerpligter og andre forhold, der indvirker på betalingsevnen. Dag- boden kan dog ikke fastsættes til et lavere beløb end 2 kr.
Stk. 2. Når bøde skal fastsættes for en forseelse, hvorved den pågældende har opnået eller tilsigtet at opnå betydelig økonomisk vinding for sig selv eller andre, og anvendelsen af dagbøder vil medføre, at bødebeløbet ansættes lavere, end det skønnes rimeligt under hensyn til størrelsen af den fortjeneste, der enten er eller kunne være opnået ved lovovertrædelsen, kan retten dog i stedet for dagbøder anvende anden straf af bøde.

Stk. 3. Ved fastsættelsen af andre bøder vil der inden for de grænser, som hensynet til lovovertrædelsens beskaffenhed og de i § 80 nævnte omstændigheder tilsteder, være at tage særligt hensyn til den skyldiges betalingsevne og til den opnåede eller tilsigtede fortjeneste eller besparelse.
Stk. 4. Politiet kan hos andre offentlige myndigheder indhente de oplysninger, der er nødvendige for bødefastsættelsen. Endvidere kan politiet fra registre, der føres af offentlige myndigheder, herunder domstolene, kræve de oplysninger om den pågældendes forhold, som findes af betydning for bødefastsæt- telsen. Oplysningerne meddeles skriftligt eller ved direkte dataoverførsel.
translated_text:
§ 51

When a fine is imposed or accepted in court pursuant to this Act, the fine is fixed in day-fines. However, this does not apply to fines imposed as an additional penalty to another legal consequence. The number of day-fines is determined having regard to the nature of the offence and the circumstances mentioned in § 80 to a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 60. The amount of each day-fine is fixed at an amount corresponding to the person's average daily income, although in fixing the amount regard should be had to the person fined's living conditions, including his assets, maintenance obligations and other circumstances affecting his ability to pay. However, the day-fine cannot be fixed at an amount lower than DKK 2.
Stk. 2. When a fine is to be fixed for an offence whereby the person has obtained or intended to obtain significant financial gain for himself or others, and the application of day-fines would result in the fine being set lower than is deemed reasonable having regard to the amount of the profit that either has been or could be obtained by the offence, the court may, however, instead of day-fines apply another fine penalty.

Stk. 3. In fixing other fines, within the limits permitted by regard to the nature of the offence and the circumstances mentioned in § 80, particular regard shall be had to the offender's ability to pay and to the profit obtained or intended or the saving made.
Stk. 4. The police may obtain from other public authorities the information necessary for fixing the fine. Furthermore, the police may require from registers kept by public authorities, including the courts, such information about the person's circumstances as is found to be of significance for fixing the fine. The information is provided in writing or by direct data transfer.

§ 53

Indgår en bøde ikke, træder i dennes sted en forvandlingsstraf af fængsel.
translated_text:
§ 52. (Repealed)

§ 53

If a fine is not paid, it is replaced by a conversion sentence of imprisonment.

text:
§ 54

Når en bøde idømmes af eller vedtages for en domstol, træffer retten samtidig med bødens fastsættelse afgørelse om forvandlingsstraffens varighed. Når bøden er fastsat som dagbod, iagttages ved forvandlingsstraffens beregning, at 1 dags fængsel svarer til 1 dagbod, dog at forvandlingsstraffen ikke kan sættes lavere end 2 dage. Er bøden fastsat på anden måde, kan forvandlingsstraffen ikke sættes lavere end 2 dage og ikke højere end 60 dage. I særlige tilfælde kan forvandlingsstraffen dog forhøjes indtil 9 måneder.
Stk. 2. Er en del af bøden betalt, bliver forvandlingsstraffen forholdsvis at nedsætte, dog således, at en del af en dag regnes som en hel dag, og at forvandlingsstraffen ikke kan nedsættes under ovennævnte mindstetid. Er en del af bøden afsonet, men resten tilbydes betalt, tages ved beregningen af denne rest alene hensyn til de hele dage, hvori forvandlingsstraf er udstået.
Stk. 3. For bøder, der idømmes juridiske personer, fastsættes ingen forvandlingsstraf.
translated_text:
§ 54

When a fine is imposed by or accepted before a court, the court decides simultaneously with fixing the fine on the duration of the conversion sentence. When the fine is fixed as day-fines, the calculation of the conversion sentence shall observe that 1 day's imprisonment corresponds to 1 day-fine, provided however that the conversion sentence cannot be set lower than 2 days. If the fine is fixed in another manner, the conversion sentence cannot be set lower than 2 days and not higher than 60 days. In special cases, however, the conversion sentence may be increased up to 9 months.
Stk. 2. If part of the fine has been paid, the conversion sentence shall be reduced proportionately, provided however that a part of a day is counted as a whole day, and that the conversion sentence cannot be reduced below the above minimum period. If part of the fine has been served, but the remainder is offered to be paid, only the whole days in which the conversion sentence has been served are taken into account in calculating this remainder.
Stk. 3. For fines imposed on legal persons, no conversion sentence is fixed.

text:

For andre bøder, der ikke er idømt af eller vedtaget for en domstol, fastsættes forvandlingsstraffen af byretten i den retskreds, hvor den pågældende bor eller opholder sig.
Stk. 2. Bestemmelserne i § 54, stk. 1, sidste punktum, og stk. 2, finder tilsvarende anvendelse.

text:
§ 56

Finder retten det upåkrævet, at straf kommer til fuldbyrdelse, bestemmes det i dommen, at spørgsmålet om straffastsættelse udsættes og bortfalder efter en prøvetid.
Stk. 2. Såfremt det må anses for mere formålstjenligt, kan retten fastsætte straffen og bestemme, at fuldbyrdelsen udsættes og bortfalder ved udløbet af prøvetiden.
Stk. 3. Udsættelsen betinges af, at den dømte ikke i prøvetiden begår strafbart forhold, og at han overholder de vilkår, som måtte være fastsat i medfør af § 57. Prøvetiden fastsættes af retten og kan i

almindelighed ikke overstige 3 år. Under særlige omstændigheder kan dog fastsættes en prøvetid på indtil 5 år.
translated_text:
§ 56

If the court finds it unnecessary for punishment to be enforced, it is determined in the judgment that the question of fixing the sentence is postponed and lapses after a probationary period.
Stk. 2. If it must be considered more expedient, the court may fix the sentence and determine that the enforcement is postponed and lapses at the expiry of the probationary period.
Stk. 3. The postponement is conditional upon the convicted person not committing a criminal offence during the probationary period and complying with any conditions that may have been fixed pursuant to § 57. The probationary period is fixed by the court and may

generally not exceed 3 years. In special circumstances, however, a probationary period of up to 5 years may be fixed.

text:
§ 57

Retten kan som vilkår for udsættelsen bestemme, at den dømte i hele prøvetiden eller en del af denne skal undergives tilsyn. Endvidere kan retten fastsætte andre vilkår, som findes formålstjenlige, herunder at den dømte
1)	overholder særlige bestemmelser vedrørende opholdssted, arbejde, uddannelse, anvendelse af fritid eller samkvem med bestemte personer,
2)	tager ophold i egnet hjem eller institution; for sådant ophold fastsættes ved dommen en længstetid, der i almindelighed ikke kan overstige 1 år,
3)	afholder sig fra misbrug af alkohol, narkotika eller lignende medikamenter,
4)	underkaster sig afvænningsbehandling for misbrug af alkohol, narkotika eller lignende medikamenter, om fornødent på hospital eller i særlig institution,
5)	underkaster sig en struktureret, kontrolleret alkoholistbehandling af mindst et års varighed,
6)	underkaster sig psykiatrisk behandling, om fornødent på hospital,
7)	retter sig efter tilsynsmyndighedens bestemmelser om indskrænkninger i rådigheden over indtægter og formue og om opfyldelse af økonomiske forpligtelser,
8)	betaler erstatning for tab, der er forvoldt ved lovovertrædelsen,
9)	efter kommunens afgørelse undergives foranstaltninger efter § 52 i lov om social service, eventuelt af nærmere angiven art, og efterkommer de forskrifter, kommunen meddeler den pågældende.
translated_text:
§ 57

The court may, as a condition for the postponement, determine that the convicted person shall be subject to supervision during the whole probationary period or part thereof. Furthermore, the court may fix other conditions considered expedient, including that the convicted person
1)	complies with special provisions concerning place of residence, work, education, use of leisure time or association with specific persons,
2)	takes up residence in a suitable home or institution; for such residence a maximum period is fixed in the judgment, which generally cannot exceed 1 year,
3)	abstains from abuse of alcohol, narcotics or similar medication,
4)	undergoes treatment for abuse of alcohol, narcotics or similar medication, if necessary in hospital or in a special institution,
5)	undergoes structured, controlled treatment for alcoholism of at least one year's duration,
6)	undergoes psychiatric treatment, if necessary in hospital,
7)	complies with the supervisory authority's decisions on restrictions on the disposal of income and assets and on the fulfilment of financial obligations,
8)	pays compensation for loss caused by the offence,
9)	undergoes measures pursuant to § 52 of the Social Services Act according to the municipality's decision, possibly of a more specifically stated nature, and complies with the instructions the municipality gives the person.

text:
§ 58

Skønnes anvendelse af ubetinget fængselsstraf påkrævet, men taler oplysningerne om tiltaltes personlige forhold for anvendelse af betinget dom efter § 56, kan retten bestemme, at en del af den forskyldte straf, dog højst 6 måneder, skal fuldbyrdes, medens dommen i øvrigt gøres betinget.
Stk. 2. I forbindelse med betinget dom kan der idømmes bøde, selv om sådan straf ikke er hjemlet for den pågældende lovovertrædelse.
translated_text:
§ 58

If the application of unconditional imprisonment is deemed necessary, but the information about the accused's personal circumstances speaks in favour of applying a conditional sentence pursuant to § 56, the court may determine that part of the sentence incurred, but not more than 6 months, shall be enforced, while the judgment is otherwise made conditional.
Stk. 2. In conjunction with a conditional sentence, a fine may be imposed even if such punishment is not provided for the offence in question.

text:
§ 59

De i medfør af § 57 fastsatte vilkår kan senere ændres eller ophæves ved retskendelse efter begæring fra anklagemyndigheden eller den dømte. Begæring fra den dømte fremsættes over for anklage- myndigheden, der snarest muligt indbringer spørgsmålet for retten. Tages en begæring fra den dømte ikke til følge, kan han ikke fremsætte ny begæring, før der er forløbet et halvt år fra kendelsens afsigelse.
Stk. 2. De i stk. 1 nævnte spørgsmål indbringes for den byret, som har pådømt sagen i første instans, eller byretten i den retskreds, hvor den dømte bor eller opholder sig. Såfremt sagen er pådømt ved landsret i første instans, træffes afgørelsen af byretten i den retskreds, hvor den dømte bor eller opholder sig.
translated_text:
§ 59

The conditions fixed pursuant to § 57 may subsequently be modified or revoked by court order upon request from the prosecution or the convicted person. A request from the convicted person is made to the prosecution, which brings the matter before the court as soon as possible. If a request from the convicted person is not granted, he cannot make a new request until six months have elapsed from the pronouncement of the order.
Stk. 2. The questions mentioned in stk. 1 are brought before the district court which tried the case at first instance, or the district court in the judicial district where the convicted person resides or is staying. If the case was tried by a high court at first instance, the decision is made by the district court in the judicial district where the convicted person resides or is staying.

text:
§ 60

Hvis den dømte overtræder de i medfør af § 57 fastsatte vilkår, kan retten i den anledning
1)	tildele advarsel,
2)	ved kendelse ændre vilkårene og forlænge prøvetiden inden for den i § 56, stk. 3, fastsatte længstetid,
3)	ved dom fastsætte straf eller anden retsfølge for den begåede lovovertrædelse eller - hvis straf er fastsat i den betingede dom - træffe afgørelse om fuldbyrdelse af denne straf.
translated_text:
§ 60

If the convicted person violates the conditions imposed pursuant to § 57, the court may on that occasion
1)	issue a warning,
2)	by order amend the conditions and extend the probation period within the maximum period specified in § 56, subsection 3,
3)	by judgment impose punishment or other legal consequence for the committed offence or - if punishment has been imposed in the conditional sentence - make a decision on enforcement of that punishment.

text:
§ 58

, stk. 1, finder tilsvarende anvendelse.
Stk. 2. Med hensyn til de i stk. 1 nævnte retsafgørelser finder § 59, stk. 2, tilsvarende anvendelse.
translated_text:
§ 58

, subsection 1, applies correspondingly.
Subsection 2. With respect to the judicial decisions mentioned in subsection 1, § 59, subsection 2, applies correspondingly.

text:
§ 61

Såfremt der inden prøvetidens udløb foretages rettergangsskridt mod den dømte, hvorved han sigtes for strafbart forhold, der er begået før den betingede dom, fastsætter retten retsfølgen for dette forhold og den tidligere pådømte lovovertrædelse.
Stk. 2. Begår den dømte nyt strafbart forhold i prøvetiden, og foretages der inden dennes udløb rettergangsskridt, hvorved han sigtes for forholdet, fastsætter retten en ubetinget straf eller anden retsfølge for dette forhold og den tidligere pådømte lovovertrædelse. Herved finder bestemmelserne i § 88, stk. 2-4, tilsvarende anvendelse. Når omstændighederne taler derfor, kan retten i stedet

1)	idømme ubetinget straf alene for det nye forhold, eventuelt i forbindelse med en ændring af vilkårene i den betingede dom, eller
2)	afsige ny betinget dom vedrørende begge lovovertrædelser eller alene for det nye forhold i overens- stemmelse med reglerne i dette eller det følgende kapitel.
translated_text:
§ 61

If, before the expiry of the probation period, legal proceedings are instituted against the convicted person, whereby he is charged with a punishable offence committed before the conditional sentence, the court shall determine the legal consequence for this offence and the previously adjudicated offence.
Subsection 2. If the convicted person commits a new punishable offence during the probation period, and legal proceedings are instituted before its expiry whereby he is charged with the offence, the court shall impose an unconditional punishment or other legal consequence for this offence and the previously adjudicated offence. In this regard, the provisions of § 88, subsections 2-4, apply correspondingly. When circumstances warrant it, the court may instead

1)	impose unconditional punishment solely for the new offence, possibly in conjunction with an amendment of the conditions in the conditional sentence, or
2)	issue a new conditional sentence concerning both offences or solely for the new offence in accordance with the rules in this or the following chapter.

text:
§ 62

Såfremt betinget dom efter reglerne i §§ 56 og 57 ikke findes tilstrækkelig, kan retten, hvis tiltalte findes egnet hertil, afsige betinget dom med vilkår om samfundstjeneste.
Stk. 2. Afgørelsen om udsættelse af fængselsstraf træffes efter reglerne i § 56, stk. 1 og 2.
Stk. 3. Udsættelsen betinges af, at den dømte ikke i en prøvetid begår strafbart forhold, og at han overholder de i medfør af § 63 fastsatte vilkår.
translated_text:
§ 62

If a conditional sentence under the rules in §§ 56 and 57 is not found sufficient, the court may, if the accused is found suitable for it, issue a conditional sentence with a condition of community service.
Subsection 2. The decision on suspension of imprisonment is made according to the rules in § 56, subsections 1 and 2.
Subsection 3. The suspension is conditional upon the convicted person not committing a punishable offence during a probation period and complying with the conditions imposed pursuant to § 63.

text:
§ 63

Som vilkår for udsættelsen af fængselsstraf bestemmes, at den dømte skal udføre ulønnet samfundstjeneste i mindst 30 og højst 300 timer. Den fastsatte arbejdspligt skal opfyldes inden for en længstetid, der udmåles i forhold til antallet af arbejdstimer.
Stk. 2. Den i medfør af stk. 1 fastsatte længstetid kan af tilsynsmyndigheden forlænges, hvis særlige grunde taler derfor, dog ikke ud over prøvetiden. Tilsynsmyndighedens afgørelse om forlængelse af længstetiden indbringes efter anmodning fra den dømte for retten.
Stk. 3. I dommen fastsættes en prøvetid på højst 2 år. Det kan i dommen bestemmes, at prøvetiden ophører, når længstetiden for arbejdsforpligtelsens opfyldelse er udløbet.
Stk. 4. Den dømte undergives tilsyn i prøvetiden. Retten kan endvidere, hvis det findes formålstjenligt, fastsætte vilkår som nævnt i § 57. Tilsynet ophører, og eventuelle vilkår efter § 57 bortfalder, når længstetiden for arbejdspligtens opfyldelse er udløbet, medmindre andet er bestemt i dommen.
translated_text:
§ 63

As a condition for the suspension of imprisonment, it is determined that the convicted person shall perform unpaid community service for at least 30 and at most 300 hours. The imposed work obligation must be fulfilled within a maximum period, which is determined in proportion to the number of work hours.
Subsection 2. The maximum period imposed pursuant to subsection 1 may be extended by the supervisory authority if special reasons warrant it, but not beyond the probation period. The supervisory authority's decision on extension of the maximum period is brought before the court at the request of the convicted person.
Subsection 3. In the judgment, a probation period of at most 2 years is determined. It may be determined in the judgment that the probation period ceases when the maximum period for fulfillment of the work obligation has expired.
Subsection 4. The convicted person is placed under supervision during the probation period. The court may furthermore, if found appropriate, impose conditions as mentioned in § 57. The supervision ceases, and any conditions under § 57 lapse, when the maximum period for fulfillment of the work obligation has expired, unless otherwise determined in the judgment.

text:
§ 64

I forbindelse med betinget dom med vilkår om samfundstjeneste kan der idømmes ubetinget fængselsstraf eller bøde efter reglerne i § 58. En i medfør af § 58, stk. 1, fastsat fængselsstraf kan dog ikke overstige 3 måneder.
translated_text:
§ 64

In connection with a conditional sentence with a condition of community service, unconditional imprisonment or a fine may be imposed according to the rules in § 58. However, an imprisonment imposed pursuant to § 58, subsection 1, may not exceed 3 months.

text:
§ 65

Bestemmelserne i § 59 om ændring eller ophævelse af vilkår finder tilsvarende anvendelse på de i medfør af § 63 trufne bestemmelser.
translated_text:
§ 65

The provisions of § 59 on amendment or revocation of conditions apply correspondingly to the decisions made pursuant to § 63.

text:
§ 66

Hvis den dømte overtræder vilkåret om samfundstjeneste eller andet vilkår, kan retten
1)	træffe afgørelse om ubetinget fængselsstraf for den begåede lovovertrædelse eller
2)	bestemme, at betinget dom skal opretholdes, eventuelt i forbindelse med en forlængelse af længsteti- den for samfundstjeneste og af prøvetiden inden for den i § 63 nævnte grænse.
Stk. 2. Ved fastsættelse af ubetinget straf efter stk. 1, nr. 1, kan § 58, stk. 1, anvendes. En betinget delstraf efter denne bestemmelse træder da i stedet for dommen til samfundstjeneste, og hertil kan knyttes de i medfør af § 63, stk. 4, fastsatte vilkår. Uanset disse bestemmelser kan der i forbindelse med fortsat samfundstjeneste idømmes en ubetinget fængselsstraf på indtil 3 måneder.
Stk. 3. Ved fastsættelse af straf skal der tages hensyn til omfanget af den samfundstjeneste, som den dømte har udført. En i medfør af § 56, stk. 2, fastsat straf kan nedsættes.
Stk. 4. Afgørelser om fuldbyrdelse af en udsat straf træffes ved dom, andre afgørelser ved kendel- se.
translated_text:
§ 66

If the convicted person violates the condition of community service or another condition, the court may
1)	make a decision on unconditional imprisonment for the committed offence or
2)	determine that the conditional sentence shall be maintained, possibly in conjunction with an extension of the maximum period for community service and of the probation period within the limit mentioned in § 63.
Subsection 2. When imposing unconditional punishment under subsection 1, no. 1, § 58, subsection 1, may be applied. A conditional partial sentence under this provision then replaces the sentence to community service, and the conditions imposed pursuant to § 63, subsection 4, may be attached thereto. Notwithstanding these provisions, an unconditional imprisonment of up to 3 months may be imposed in conjunction with continued community service.
Subsection 3. When imposing punishment, regard shall be had to the extent of the community service which the convicted person has performed. A punishment imposed pursuant to § 56, subsection 2, may be reduced.
Subsection 4. Decisions on enforcement of a suspended punishment are made by judgment, other decisions by order.

text:
§ 59

, stk. 2, finder tilsvarende anvendelse.
translated_text:
§ 59

, subsection 2, applies correspondingly.

Reglerne i § 61 finder tilsvarende anvendelse i sager om personer, som efter betinget dom med vilkår om samfundstjeneste sigtes for et strafbart forhold begået før eller efter dommen.
Stk. 2. Såfremt en ubetinget delstraf idømmes efter § 58, stk. 1, eller § 61, stk. 2, nr. 1, træder for den øvrige strafs vedkommende en betinget dom efter 7.
translated_text:
§ 67
